Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: privacy annex & DPIA schedule for CF EMS procurement

Hi Marcus —

Thanks for the demo last week. Cedar Falls Procurement needs to collect the privacy addendum (DPA + SCCs notes) and a DPIA timeline before the board packet on Dec 15. A few concrete asks we need this week to stay on track: 

- A draft privacy annex (DPA + SCCs) in track-changes or DocuSign-ready form.
- A DPIA questionnaire or an estimate of time to complete the DPIA template (we'll attach ours).
- SOC 2 evidence index / CAI mapping that shows controls applicable to data residency, encryption, and incident response.

Can you also confirm whether any FedRAMP-adjacent controls are documented (e.g., CSP boundary diagrams, network segmentation notes) — state auditors will ask.

Attachments: CF_DPIA_Template_v2.docx (procurement)

Target: procurement wants a first cut by Dec 3 and finalized redlines by Dec 10. Let me know if that timeline is feasible.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Kemp
Senior Procurement Analyst
Cedar Falls County

Subject: Re: Request: privacy annex & DPIA schedule for CF EMS procurement

Hi Sarah —

Appreciate the clear timeline. We can meet the Dec 3 first-cut target. Proposed plan:

1) Today (Dec 1): Share a DPA/privacy annex template with Redwood standard redlines + a one-page SOC 2 summary. (attached)
2) Dec 2–3: Our security team completes an initial DPIA response against your template and provides a list of outstanding vendor-specific questions.
3) Dec 4–7: Legal & procurement redline cycle (Laura will own redlines).
4) Dec 8–10: Finalize annex and prepare DocuSign envelope for signatures.

I attached: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (SOC 2 scope + high-level controls) and a link to a shared evidence folder. Mina will upload the SOC 2 CAI mapping and CAIQ partials by EOD Dec 2.

Proposed meeting: Dec 3, 11:00–11:30 AM CST to walk the annex and DPIA gaps. Does that work for your team?

Best,
Marcus Lin
Head of Sales Engineering — Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

Sarah / Marcus —

Quick legal notes on the annex:
- We will provide a redlineable DPA that includes SCC references and a clause for limited subprocessor disclosures.
- For FedRAMP-adjacent requirements: we can add a short appendix describing boundary controls, but we cannot represent Redwood as FedRAMP-authorized. We'll be explicit about control alignment only.
- Please indicate whether the county requires export-control language (data crossing international borders) — that changes the SCC wording.

Action items for procurement: send the final DPIA template (if there are local fields beyond the doc you attached) so we can populate every required field.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Kemp <sarah.kemp@cedarfalls.gov>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: SOC 2 CAI mapping + CAIQ partials for Cedar Falls

Hi all —

Attaching the initial evidence bundle. Highlights:
- Encryption: AES-256 at rest; TLS 1.3 in transit. Key management: KMS (customer CMK via KMS/HSM optional on Redwood Private).
- Access control: RBAC + SSO (SAML/OIDC) with MFA enforced for privileged roles.
- Logging & Audit: Per-route request logs retained 90 days by default; extended retention available per contract.
- Incident response: 24x7 on-call ops; SOC 2 CAI IDs mapped in soc2-caii-mapping.csv.

Attachments: soc2-caii-mapping.csv (CSV), ca iq_partial_responses.xlsx (Excel)

Note: The CAIQ is partially completed where vendor-specific evidence exists. For items flagged 'customer to confirm', we'll need Cedar Falls to confirm expected data flows and retention choices (fields in your DPIA).

Mina Haddad
Security Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
Attachment stubs: soc2-caii-mapping.csv, ca iq_partial_responses.xlsx

Thanks — the attachments look good. A few items before the board packet:

Best,
Sarah
